rejected_rule.statement: A constructive trust will be formed if one can prove that in the attendant circumstances that if the donor did not intend to transfer the beneficial interest, even though the written document appears to speak otherwise.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: In the instant case I have to look deep into the High Court Judges' analysis of the evidence considered by the District Judge to decide whether any attendant circumstances were present to prove that the transferor did not intend to transfer the beneficial interest to the transferee in Deed 3344 aforementioned. Section 83 of the Trusts Ordinance provides that if one can prove that in the attendant circumstances that if the donor did not intend to transfer the beneficial interest, even though the written document appears to speak otherwise, a constructive trust will be formed.
